metadata.host_selection_rule: storage-only: direct child contract with most references; lexical canonical-id tie-break

semantics.eligibility_rule: Only committed/eligible source changes propagate according to the sync profile.
semantics.change_rule: Each propagated change references exact source record/resource, revision and originating write/transaction where available.
semantics.order_rule: Apply order follows the source sync-position profile, not arrival order alone.
semantics.schema_rule: Destination compatibility/schema mapping is validated before apply.
semantics.lineage_rule: Replicated data retains authoritative source lineage.
semantics.idempotency_rule: Repeated delivery of the same exact change is idempotent according to change identity/profile.
semantics.authority_rule: Receiving a change does not bypass destination-side write/governance checks required by the replication profile.

invariants.rule: Replica/sync state, transport position or local copy never replaces the semantic identity or ownership of the authoritative source data; propagation is explicit, provenance-bearing and conflict-aware.

hard_gates.condition: duplicate delivery creates duplicate semantic state
